baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative binds ءَالَاءِ, رَبِّكُمَا, and تُكَذِّبَانِ in the dual.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bestowed favors issue from lordly ownership and are met by a joint act of declaring their reality or source false.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors are the objects placed under question.
Lordship, possession, and authority identify the favors' giver and claimant.
Declaring a thing or its bearer false makes denial an attribution, not mere ignorance.

changed_reading.before: The verse generally asks what the pair rejects.
changed_reading.after: It asks which bestowed favors of their owning Lord the two will positively classify as false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَبِّكُمَا governs the favors while تُكَذِّبَانِ supplies the pair's response.
baseline_models.mechanism: A favor can be a stage-by-stage act of repair and completion; denial can make that entrusted trajectory prove false by failing to carry it through.

activation_trace.role: The favor branch supplies what is given for the recipients' benefit.
Repair, nurture, and completion turn lordship into an ongoing formative process.
A charge that proves true or fails supplies the performative test of the recipients.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a verbal verdict on completed gifts.
changed_reading.after: The question also asks which acts of cultivation the pair will falsify by not completing their entrusted effect.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same three focus roots carry oath, pact, and incumbent-response branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative can function as a covenant-like summons: lordly benefaction binds, and the pair must take recognition upon themselves rather than merely offer an opinion.

activation_trace.role: The oath branch lends the questioned term a binding, attestational pressure.
The pact branch supplies a protected relation under which the Lord's claim is heard.
The idiom of urging or obligation makes the challenge performative: take this upon yourselves.

changed_reading.before: The pair is asked for a cognitive judgment.
changed_reading.after: The pair is summoned to answer a binding benefaction-claim and cannot remain neutral toward it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split mapping of ءَالَاءِ activates a voice-following-voice branch inside the dual question.
baseline_models.mechanism: The line can be heard as a response-slot: one voice advances the Lord's claim and a following dual voice is expected to answer it.

activation_trace.role: A voice following another voice supplies the latent call-and-response form.
Lordly authority gives the initiating voice its claim on both addressees.
The denial verb defines the answer the recurring question presses them to disavow.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is a self-contained rhetorical question.
changed_reading.after: The ayah opens an answer-turn in which the two addressed voices must follow the initiating claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same dual refrain repeatedly follows scene after scene and brackets 55:55, strengthening the form-distant voice-following-voice branch into an antiphonal response architecture.

activation_trace.role: The earlier refrain realizes one responsive voice-turn before the focus scene.
At focus, the following-voice image makes the repeated question an expected answer-slot.
The later refrain resumes the same vocal succession after the next scene.

structural_cues: The identical four-word dual refrain occurs at 55:53, 55:55, and 55:57 and throughout the packet window.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact recurrence plus the branch image of one voice following another; the reader infers an antiphonal turn assigned to the dual audience; alternatively, the recurrence may remain a one-voice rhetorical device with no audible reply.

changed_reading.before: The question repeats only for emphasis.
changed_reading.after: Each recurrence offers the two addressees a fresh response-turn, so silence or denial itself becomes part of the scene.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cosmic balance becomes commanded equity and can be shortchanged; the focus denial therefore has a behavioral mode in which a bestowed measure is made false by its users.

activation_trace.role: The balance literally carries justice and equity, supplying the norm to be enacted.
Equity and fair dealing specify the human realization of the given balance.
Shortchanging measure supplies the concrete failure that makes the entrusted order untrue in practice.
A charge proving true or false transfers denial from speech into carried-through performance.

structural_cues: 55:7-9 moves from a placed cosmic balance to commands not to exceed it and to establish weight justly.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, equity, shortchanging, and the charge-performance branch; the reader infers that conduct can falsify a favor's intended order; alternatively, conduct may merely evidence a prior verbal or cognitive denial.

changed_reading.before: To deny a favor is to call it unreal.
changed_reading.after: To deny it can be to underperform the just measure it enables, making the Lord's charge fail in one's own action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dual address is embedded in repeated paired systems that join counterparts without erasing their boundary; the two recipients become co-witnesses whose responses remain distinct but mutually exposed.

activation_trace.role: Mixing and disorder supply the pressure under which paired seas could lose distinction.
A relation standing between endpoints lets separation itself connect the pair.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart gives the garden abundance a paired form.
One Lord's authority holds both addressees inside the same interrogative claim.

structural_cues: The dual forms in 55:55 echo two easts and wests, two seas, two gardens, two springs, and paired fruits.
The uncited barrier phrase at 55:20 prevents paired meeting from becoming transgressive collapse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dual grammar and paired-but-bounded systems; the reader infers joint testimony in which each addressee's answer bears on the other; alternatively, the dual may identify human and jinn without adding mutual accountability.

changed_reading.before: Two recipients happen to receive the same question.
changed_reading.after: The pair is examined as a coupled but non-collapsed witness-system: which corresponding favors will either of you refuse to attest?

context_deltas.mechanism: At its exact location, the refrain names a coordinated favor: fruition is brought near, hidden worth exceeds the visible surface, and intimacy remains bounded rather than consumed without limit.

activation_trace.role: A garment's inner lining makes concealed material quality part of the offered scene.
Taking ripe produce from its source supplies fruition ready for acquisition.
Nearness removes friction between the recipient and the garden's yield.
The favor branch gathers the spatial and material arrangement as a benefaction.
Being kept to a limit supplies restraint that preserves rather than negates intimacy.
The glance and sight localize that restraint in attention itself.

structural_cues: 55:55 sits between reclining on brocade-lined furnishings with near fruit and the bounded-gaze scene of 55:56.
The branchless ط م ث occurrence at 55:56 is used only as a structural cue for untouchedness; no mapped or branch identifier is inferred for it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interior lining, harvest, nearness, restrained gaze, and untouchedness; the reader infers one mechanism of accessible abundance under intact boundaries; alternatively, the adjacent verses may enumerate separate pleasures without making their coordination the favor.

changed_reading.before: The refrain labels the preceding objects as pleasant gifts.
changed_reading.after: It challenges denial of an arrangement in which yield is near and inwardly rich while desire remains protected by limits.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence moves from disclosure to measured creation to expressive clarification and calculation; repeated questioning functions as assessment inside a curriculum of lordly formation.

activation_trace.role: A thing becoming uncovered to a knower supplies the first pedagogical movement.
Measuring and proportioning make creation a calibrated formation rather than bare production.
Uncovering meaning through speech or sign gives the formed recipient an answering capacity.
Counting and reckoning place the celestial scene inside intelligible measure.
Repair, nurture, and completion unify the stages as a Lord-led curriculum.

structural_cues: The packet opens with teaching, creating, teaching expression, calculated celestial motion, and a commanded balance before recurring assessment refrains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequenced set of formative acts and the nurture branch; the reader infers curriculum and assessment as their directional relation; alternatively, these may be parallel favors without a pedagogical progression.

changed_reading.before: The refrain inventories benefits already possessed.
changed_reading.after: It is an assessment checkpoint asking which stage of being taught, formed, enabled to express, and measured the pair will refuse to learn from.

context_deltas.mechanism: Because the refrain also follows transgression, blocked escape, failed aid, exposure, and encountered denial, favor broadens from agreeable provision to limit-setting that makes moral reality impossible to evade.

activation_trace.role: Crossing a limit in disobedience identifies the excess that the given measure restrains.
Transgressive injustice makes a preserved boundary morally functional.
Passing cleanly to the other side supplies the escape repeatedly attempted and denied without authority.
Aid and vindication are explicitly unavailable, making consequence non-negotiable.
What criminals declared false becomes the encountered object, collapsing denial into exposure.
The favor branch forces the difficult question of how severe disclosure can still benefit the addressees.

structural_cues: The same refrain follows warning and judgment blocks in 55:31-45 as well as ordered creation and garden abundance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same refrain after both delight and severe limits; the reader infers that truthful boundary-setting can itself be benefaction; alternatively, ءَالَاءِ may broaden there to signs or powers rather than pleasant favors.

changed_reading.before: Only agreeable gifts are candidates for denial.
changed_reading.after: The pair is also challenged over unwelcome disclosures and limits whose benefit is precisely that reality cannot be escaped or transgressed without consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Perishing recipients, the remaining Lord, daily affairs, running springs, and gushing water recast favor as continuously renewed flow rather than an inert possession; denial can take the form of expecting provision to fail.

activation_trace.role: Cessation after duration makes created possession intrinsically unable to secure its own continuance.
Remaining and endurance locate continuity in the Lord rather than in the supplied objects.
Ongoing affair and condition give divine provision a recurring temporal activity.
Continuous provision and giving are carried by the running springs.
Provision that disappears instead of lasting supplies the expectation-failure mode of denial.
Water welling abundantly intensifies the image from steady flow to self-renewing surplus.

structural_cues: 55:26-29 juxtaposes universal passing, the Lord's remaining, and daily activity; both garden sequences then foreground active springs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies perishability, continuance, daily action, and flowing provision; the reader infers renewal from one source and treats expected interruption as a denial mechanism; alternatively, the temporal and garden images may form separate contrasts.

changed_reading.before: A favor is a stable object one either acknowledges or rejects.
changed_reading.after: A favor is a sustained relation of replenishment, and denial includes assuming the source will fail when the current portion passes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later equivalence of excellence with its recompense activates the focus oath, pact, and obligation branches as a reciprocal answer to benefaction rather than a one-way inventory.

activation_trace.role: The oath branch gives recognition the pressure of attestation.
A covenant or protection pact supplies the durable relation in which response is due.
The urging idiom turns the refrain from observation toward incumbent response.
Meeting an act with its recompense supplies the return movement of the relation.
Doing what is good appears on both sides of the equivalence and names the quality of answer.

structural_cues: The symmetrical question at 55:60 is bracketed by the identical refrains at 55:59 and 55:61.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense, doubled excellence, and focus oath-pact branches; the reader infers reciprocal obligation; alternatively, 55:60 may describe divine reward alone without making the recipients' acknowledgment contractual.

changed_reading.before: The Lord gives and the pair merely recognizes the gift.
changed_reading.after: Benefaction opens a reciprocal bond: which binding good will the pair refuse to answer with an answering excellence?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a botanical homonym instead of the ordinary favor sense; it remains anchored to the exact focus inventory and to branch, fruit, and green-growth context; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, not as a replacement translation of ءَالَاءِ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun's plant branch describes an attractive but bitter growth inside an extended garden sequence.

activation_trace.role: A branching limb supplies the garden structure in which the botanical activation can live.
Fruit gathered from its source places taste and yield beside visual abundance.
The named plant's attractive appearance and bitter taste introduce mixed sensory value.
Fresh green vegetation sustains the ecological rather than abstract setting.

changed_reading.before: A favor should be immediately agreeable in every register.
changed_reading.after: The garden analogy permits a favor to be beautiful yet bitter, challenging rejection that mistakes sweetness for the only form of benefit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain formal analogy from a distant ك ذ ب branch: a creature runs a stage and stops to look behind. Repeated refrains visibly support the pause-and-review shape and the focus verb anchors it, but downstream prose must label it a discourse-motion analogy rather than a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تُكَذِّبَانِ closes a short scene and the same verb closes matching refrains before and after it.

activation_trace.role: Running a stage then stopping to look back models the earlier refrain as retrospective pause.
At focus, the same motion image turns the denial question backward over the just-completed furnishing and fruit scene.
The next recurrence confirms a repeated run-pause-review cadence rather than a one-off stop.

changed_reading.before: The refrain is punctuation between scenes.
changed_reading.after: It is a deliberate backward glance after each discursive run, requiring the pair to review what has just passed before proceeding.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is surprising because the focus denial verb reaches a branch about patterned cloth whose appearance misreports its state. The nearby inner lining and later figured textile keep the material analogy anchored, but downstream prose should not claim that the verse condemns the fabrics themselves; the live point is surface versus hidden structure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تُكَذِّبَانِ stands immediately after a furnishing whose valuable lining is specifically interior.

activation_trace.role: Spread furnishing supplies the textile surface on which appearance is first encountered.
The garment lining locates decisive worth beneath rather than on the visible face.
A variegated cloth that deceives by its condition supplies the material model of misreading appearance.
Fine patterned spreads reactivate the appearance-rich textile domain later in the same garden sequence.

changed_reading.before: Denial occurs only through an explicit false statement.
changed_reading.after: Denial can also be a surface error: allowing decorated appearance to lie about the hidden depth of what has been given.

strongest_changes: The refrain becomes a recurring response-turn rather than a detached rhetorical question.
Denial moves from speech into enacted falsification under the commands of measure and equity.
At 55:55, favor is the coordination of near fruition, hidden worth, and preserved limits.
The dual audience is sharpened by a paired-but-bounded architecture of joint witness.
Warnings and continuously renewed flows broaden favor beyond pleasant, static objects.
summary.what_was_special: Split-root and material branches exposed several coexisting mechanisms that a favors-only reading suppresses: antiphonal answer, covenantal charge, backward review, bitter beauty, and the risk of mistaking surface for interior value.
remaining_uncertainties: The ت ل و activations are packet-authorized split mappings but remain form-distant and should not displace the dominant ء ل و sense.
Severe warning may count as beneficent boundary-setting, or ءَالَاءِ may broaden there from favors toward signs and powers.
Paired context strongly fits the dual grammar, but mutual accountability beyond simple human-jinn address remains inferred.
The botanical, animal-motion, and textile models are explanatory analogies, not replacement lexical translations.
